fusions.name: Visor Thrust
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Glinting Plate
fusions.desc: You flash light off your plate, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds, its critical chance lowered.

fusions.name: Seen Coming
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds, and gives you 8% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Seam Sight
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
